question: Which of the following states won the highest number of medals overall (gold, silver, bronze combined) in National-Games 2025?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Maharashtra**__.

• **Maharashtra** secured the **first position** in the overall medal tally at the **National Games 2025**, continuing its dominant run in Indian domestic sports.
 
• The state was awarded the prestigious **Raja Bhalindra Singh Trophy**, which is presented to the overall champion of the **National Games**.
